purpose: Exact pinned source handoff for M12 Dev View implementation

394-contract-foundation.instruction: Accept and maintain the contract package; no donor implementation is copied in this slice.

units.action: Translate component decomposition, navigation hierarchy, archive shelf, and panel registry interactions to Solid; retain Adea tokens and platform provider.

Copy pure operations, then narrow n-ary/global representation to Adea strict binary scoped layout. Shared UI issue #22 extracts the already-adapted Adea layout/operations.ts model rather than recopying a second tree; preserve payload-generic visual identities and inject the final-pane placeholder. Scoped persistence and unknown-version recovery remain application-owned. The model checkpoint does not establish the accessible shell renderer. The issue-backed renderer foundation uses stable ID-keyed opaque leaf owners; maintained Corvu separators receive host resize/focus/close callbacks. Scoped persistence, host runtime services, user-facing move controls and full shell/product adoption stay separate.

Translate invariants and all applicable test cases to TypeScript. The shared model checkpoint reuses the existing Adea strict-binary adaptation; native TabArea/TerminalTab projection and geometry/rendering acceptance remain separate from pure operations. Translate the reviewed areaFrames fractional geometry to a Map keyed by opaque identity, retaining row/column offsets and exact node references while applying accepted 0.1–0.9 ratio repair. Native UI is not copied. Keep leaf DOM separate from changing branch-controller ancestry; prove owner/value/caret/focus retention in Chromium and WebKit.
Port as primary service; preserve proof-before-trash and rename-before-delete; add M10 scope, identity generations, durable journal, leases, and complete blockers.
Translate staged UX and race fixtures; replace cwd/PID/PGID/lsof ownership with Adea launch identity.
Translate behavior and fixtures into bounded TypeScript modules; preserve prune-first discovery and workspace semantics.
Adapt normalized group/project/repository relations and row hierarchy with runtime-node scope; translate AddRepoDialog and worktree-list hierarchy interactions to Solid.
Adapt relationship model only; durable authority remains execution host and Control Plane.
Copy adapter shape and Bun spawn lifecycle; replace decoded string callbacks with Uint8Array and detached sidecar authority.
Copy queue, reconnect, heartbeat, and stale-socket mechanics; add authenticated endpoint, byte sequence, checkpoints, replay, resync, and generation.
Port worktree history/startup assembly; use relative content-addressed authority and fresh containment proof.
Translate bounded renderer credit and environment allowlist; do not treat credit as authentication, ownership, or replay.
Translate component hierarchy and interactions to Solid/CodeMirror; retain test behaviors; replace Tauri authority and listed filesystem/save/search defects.
Copy checkpoint/editor contracts and git parser behavior; add M10 root identity, CAS save, NUL-safe parsing, plan/commit, and retention.
Copy identity/write-gate reducers and bounded parser tests; replace heuristic authority with RuntimeSession/HarnessRun generation and event precedence.
Translate ACP lifecycle and failure tests behind M10 discovery/protocol authority.
Translate harness registry, model/command, preference, archive, and history models while keeping M10/M11 authority.
Copy/translate explicit preference precedence and reset behavior; never inherit credentials from persona identity.
Use only as degraded-detection fixture/test inspiration; M10 discovery and authenticated native/ACP events remain authoritative.

Review-only aggregation references: model-catalog accepts unrestricted stdout and provider naming heuristics, and useUpdateInventory is a static-staleness system/host update hook rather than a runtime-node harness registry; port only bounded typed-aggregation ideas.
Translate explicit transport kinds, capability surface, BrowserView lifecycle, annotation, and tests; replace Electron/Python seams with ADR 0006 Bun.WebView/CDP/M10 lanes.
Port target/session/CDP/emulator/cookie/annotation flows; replace Electron seams with Bun.WebView/CDP/M10 and add ADR 0006 lane identities.
Port preview, port, picker, annotation, and mini-player UX; replace permissive permissions and partial cookie import.
Copy provider client and test fixtures; replace IPC/vault seams with M10, preserve pagination/rate/error behavior, add plan/commit and reconciliation.
Translate PR/check/work-item information hierarchy to Solid with untrusted-text sanitization.

Adopt remote-ref and PR/check/review/provider DTO and cache/rate-limit patterns; Adea's force-with-lease confirmation, idempotent PR reconciliation, custom-host credential scoping, and update-branch policy remain independent gates.
Translate process-tree measurement and race tests; replace cwd/name/PID/PGID/lsof ownership.
Copy usage source separation and presentation contracts; replace configurable credential-forwarding URL with fixed trusted-host adapters.
Use only for process-memory/local-usage presentation evidence and rejected singleton/remote-unavailable behavior; these units provide no port/process ownership and are not cleanup executors.

424-resources-cleanup.instruction: Reuse the already-proven Adea terminal history and worktree archive/trash services produced by #396/#397; do not recopy or independently translate their Orca donors in #424.

units.action: Translate complete appearance state and interactions; add accent, surface, reduced transparency, and shared xterm/CodeMirror roles.
Translate category rail, search, installed/discover, and detail composition to Solid over Adea verified catalog/install plans.

Preserve the already accepted Adea appearance composition while extracting controlled Solid presentation to the standalone adea-ai/ui appearance-editor composite: split System miniatures, independent Light/Dark rows, palette bands, accent and surface helper copy. Translate the embedded three-mode, both-appearance and helper-copy tests; font controls/tests remain excluded by #425 amendments. Palette authority remains in themes, and preferences/preview/persistence/native effects remain in application adapters. No GPUI dependency is introduced.

Translate the status pane and per-row action pattern (status chip copy and tone, Request vs Open Settings affordance, focus-return re-check, no nag loops) to a Solid pane over Adea tokens. States come only from the injected probe service port; the typed-unavailable service replaces the donor's Electron systemPreferences calls so the web lane renders honest Cannot-check rows. The donor's local-network connection test, USB/Bluetooth/Full Disk rows, and toast plumbing are out of M12 scope (no shipped feature needs them).

Translate the snapshot-with-injectable-probes structure and the single-flight refresh coordinator into the shell's fixed-argv probe registry: osascript Accessibility and Apple Events probes with a bounded deadline mapping a pending consent prompt to not_determined; the trust-settling poll collapses into the deadline semantics because a Bun lane has no synchronous AX trust API. Scripted runners replay the donor tests' outcome matrix.

Translate the permission preflight structure (no capture/input begins unless a probe proves its TCC service), the trust-settling deadline semantics, and the snapshot cache policy (a cached permission answer is never presented as fresh; bounded newest-snapshot retention) into the computer-use lane's authority gate: consent records re-check #471 probe freshness inside their window, frames follow the bounded newest-frame cache policy, and ScreenCapturePermissionPreflightSafety's rule — capture refuses closed when the recording grant cannot be proven — becomes typed capability_unavailable while the native helper stays deferred. Scripted runners replay the outcome matrices; no real capture or input runs in CI.

Mine only the host-side plumbing shape (a supervised runtime host owning lane lifecycle plus a rendering seam that projects desktop snapshots into a bounded client view); the Electron/remote-desktop transport is replaced by Adea's desktop-frames-v1 stream, the M10 gate, and the #472 consent gate. Donor code is not copied verbatim from this unit.

426-integration-release-gate.instruction: Do not copy new donor production code here; port any remaining applicable test fixtures from every validated slice and run the complete packaged release matrix.

units.action: The #532-approved KiroCrew composer/goal flow includes IME input ownership. Preserve the native latch and textarea composition/commit/blur recovery contract when hardening shared MessageComposer. Translate native/browser-signal, post-composition-window, back-to-back and abandoned-composition test behavior. React synthetic event propagation and document focus-trap tracking are excluded from this textarea-scoped port; maintained Kobalte primitives still own overlays. This selected-unit handoff does not certify the full Chat composition or its production mount.

Translate the full plain-scroller follow lifecycle and its pure decision core into shared ConversationSurface: content/viewport ResizeObserver, user-vs-self scroll, synchronous scroll-up race guard, directional re-engagement, content shrink and viewport clamp distinctions, instant pins and cleanup. Keep virtual row measurement/anchor persistence outside the plain scroller; applications own canonical identity and scroll restoration. Preserve the existing configurable visibility threshold; use an action label rather than estimating unread messages from pixel distance. No virtualizer, React runtime or session store is copied.

Translate the complete split send action and described steer/queue mode picker into shared presentation. Preserve independently available mode choice, controlled selected mode, action-only fire, selected treatment and capability-gated alternate-action hint. React/manual portal/outside listeners/keyboard navigation are replaced with maintained Kobalte menu behavior; Kobalte Tab prevention lacks enabled-row cycling, so the mapped hook's Tab cycle is translated as a menu-scoped handler with no document listener. Donor localStorage migration/broadcast/session-slot ownership stays app-owned and is not copied. Unsupported action modes are visibly disabled with injected reasons. No runtime commands, queue store or host authority is added; donor force-reset timer is excluded pending runtime authorization review. The full ChatInput parent has now been read; product Chat composition and application adoption remain pending.

Translate the reviewed composer visual hierarchy and controlled reading-collapse/focus seams into shared ChatComposer: knowledge/follow-ups, adjacent band, approval and notices, staged content, input/action groups and a context shelf. Preserve labeled restoration, unmounted collapsed input/shelf, host-owned draft and scoped typing intent. Kobalte replaces manual menus. Persisted preferences, global broadcasts/shortcuts, approval policy, voice capture, upload transport, optimizer, paste authority and runtime session state remain app-owned; existing selected IME and busy units compose without reimplementation. This selected composition is not full Chat product or canonical runtime adoption. Preserve per-action non-text payload eligibility: reference-only drafts may send/queue but cannot steer. Native field sizing preserves growth/cap/width behavior on the verified engines; legacy fallback and the remaining rich composer features are separately pending.

Translate the complete reusable paste-token model into adea-ai/ui packages/ui/src/components/conversation/paste-tokens.ts: block shape, thresholds, deterministic token formatting/ranges, sequence allocation/remapping, pruning, expansion and re-collapse. Retain pure trailing-blank-line policy from composerPastePolicy. Read the full selected files and nearest tests; separate localStorage recovery/side tables and backend-message reconciliation from pure transformations, inject any required identity rather than importing app state. Browser clipboard/File interpretation, upload transport, textarea atomic editing, undo/history, mirror/preview/chips and host submit-block/persistence integration remain separately mapped continuation work; this model does not certify rich editing, full Chat, release or production adoption. Preserve pinned Apache-2.0 attribution and use Bun tests without donor React/Lexical/runtime dependencies.

dependencyPolicy: Manifests are review inputs, not dependency grants. Classify every selected unit import as standard, local-translated, existing Adea dependency, or proposed dependency. Do not add a donor package/runtime transitively; any proposed dependency requires exact version, license, distribution impact, security review, and same-change lockfile evidence.
